notice: Synthetic public test seeds. Never trust these keys. Inputs are exact bytes (unpadded base64url). Only 'expect' is normative; 'reason' is informative.

bundle_cases.name: accept/pinned-issuer-valid-time
bundle_cases.reason: A fully delegated bundle, pinned to its issuer's exact issuer+key, verifies with a matching artifact.

bundle_cases.name: accept/artifact-content-changed
bundle_cases.reason: A same-length substituted artifact still fails artifact_match even though the bundle itself verifies.

bundle_cases.name: accept/artifact-length-changed
bundle_cases.reason: A different-length substituted artifact fails artifact_match.

bundle_cases.name: accept/no-policy
bundle_cases.reason: With no supplied trust policy, issuer_trust and freshness are unknown rather than accepted or untrusted.

bundle_cases.name: accept/issuer-only-policy
bundle_cases.reason: An issuer alone, without a trusted key, is not enough to accept by policy.

bundle_cases.name: accept/key-only-policy
bundle_cases.reason: A trusted key alone, without an expected issuer, is not enough to accept by policy.

bundle_cases.name: accept/wrong-issuer-policy
bundle_cases.reason: The right key but a different expected issuer does not yield accepted_by_policy.

bundle_cases.name: accept/wrong-key-policy
bundle_cases.reason: The right issuer but a wrong trusted key does not yield accepted_by_policy.

bundle_cases.name: accept/expired-at-evaluation
bundle_cases.reason: Evaluating long after certificate expiry still verifies the signature; freshness reports expired.

bundle_cases.name: accept/not-yet-valid-at-evaluation
bundle_cases.reason: Evaluating before the certificate's issued_at reports not_yet_valid.

bundle_cases.name: accept/expiry-boundary-is-exclusive
bundle_cases.reason: Evaluating exactly at the certificate's expires_at reports expired: the interval is half-open.

bundle_cases.name: accept/issue-boundary-is-inclusive
bundle_cases.reason: Evaluating exactly at the certificate's issued_at reports valid_at_evaluation_time: the interval is half-open.

bundle_cases.name: accept/producer-only-delegated
bundle_cases.reason: A delegated bundle without a certificate is producer_only: no issuer trust or freshness is established even though a delegation exists.

bundle_cases.name: accept/producer-only-key-profile
bundle_cases.reason: The bare key profile (no delegation, no certificate) verifies as producer_only with no agent binding, and an empty artifact still matches.

bundle_cases.name: accept/self-issued-urn-issuer
bundle_cases.reason: A single key can self-issue its own certificate without any registration profile.

bundle_cases.name: accept/outer-whitespace-and-reordered-members
bundle_cases.reason: Outer bundle/envelope member order and insignificant whitespace do not affect verification.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-digest-zeroed
bundle_cases.reason: A statement envelope whose payload_sha256 no longer matches its actual payload is rejected before any signature check.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-replaced
bundle_cases.reason: Swapping the statement payload without updating its digest is caught by the digest check.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-replaced-consistent-digest
bundle_cases.reason: Swapping the statement payload and updating its digest to match still fails: the original signature no longer covers the new bytes.

bundle_cases.name: reject/signature-bit-flipped
bundle_cases.reason: Flipping one bit of the certificate signature invalidates it.

bundle_cases.name: reject/signature-padded
bundle_cases.reason: A padded ('=') certificate signature is not valid unpadded base64url and fails to decode.

bundle_cases.name: reject/signature-truncated
bundle_cases.reason: Dropping the last two characters of the certificate signature yields the wrong decoded length.

bundle_cases.name: reject/standard-base64-alphabet
bundle_cases.reason: Standard base64 characters (+/) substituted into statement.signature.value, where only unpadded base64url (-_) is valid, are rejected as invalid encoding rather than silently normalized.

bundle_cases.name: reject/public-key-swapped
bundle_cases.reason: Substituting the certificate signature's public key with the statement's agent key no longer fingerprints to the declared issuer key_id.

bundle_cases.name: reject/key-id-swapped
bundle_cases.reason: Substituting the certificate signature's key_id with the statement's agent key_id no longer matches the certificate's real public key.

bundle_cases.name: reject/acceptance-null-with-delegation
bundle_cases.reason: A delegation present without its matching acceptance is an incomplete registration.

bundle_cases.name: reject/delegation-null-with-acceptance
bundle_cases.reason: An acceptance present without its matching delegation is an incomplete registration.

bundle_cases.name: reject/extra-top-level-member
bundle_cases.reason: An unknown top-level bundle member is rejected outright; the bundle schema is closed.

bundle_cases.name: reject/missing-certificate-member
bundle_cases.reason: Optional bundle attachments must be explicit nulls; omitting the certificate member entirely is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/protocol-member-capitalized
bundle_cases.reason: Bundle field names are exact and case-sensitive; a capitalized 'Protocol' does not satisfy the lowercase 'protocol' field.

bundle_cases.name: reject/envelope-unknown-member
bundle_cases.reason: An unknown member inside an envelope is rejected outright, the same as at the top level.

bundle_cases.name: reject/envelope-missing-member
bundle_cases.reason: A required envelope member (payload_sha256) that is missing entirely is rejected by the outer canonical-field check.

bundle_cases.name: reject/wrong-bundle-protocol
bundle_cases.reason: A bundle-level protocol identifier from a different version is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/wrong-envelope-protocol
bundle_cases.reason: An envelope-level protocol identifier that does not match the bundle's is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/unsupported-algorithm
bundle_cases.reason: A signature algorithm other than Ed25519 is rejected; there is no negotiation or fallback.

bundle_cases.name: reject/statement-null
bundle_cases.reason: A null statement is rejected: the bundle's statement member must be an actual envelope object.

bundle_cases.name: reject/statement-is-array
bundle_cases.reason: A statement member of the wrong JSON type (an array instead of an object) is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-utf8-bom-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: A UTF-8 BOM before an otherwise-canonical, validly signed payload is not insignificant JSON whitespace and is rejected as malformed.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-leading-space-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: A leading space before an otherwise-canonical, validly signed payload is legal JSON whitespace but is not canonical.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-trailing-newline-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: A trailing newline after an otherwise-canonical, validly signed payload is legal JSON whitespace but is not canonical.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-members-reordered-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: A validly signed payload with the same members in non-canonical order re-canonicalizes to different bytes and is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-escaped-solidus-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: A validly signed payload that escapes '/' as \/ is legal JSON but not the canonical (unescaped) form.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-unicode-escape-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: A validly signed payload that writes a printable ASCII character as a \uXXXX escape is legal JSON but not the canonical (literal) form.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-duplicate-member-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: Duplicating the payload's first member is rejected at the structural level before any canonical-form or field check.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-number-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: A JSON numeric token in place of the decimal-string artifact_size is rejected outright: 0.1 exact quantities are always strings.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-null-member-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: A null nonce is legal, canonical-stable JSON, but fails the required-field format check the same as an empty one.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-missing-member-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: Removing the nonce member entirely fails the required-field format check.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-unknown-member-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: An unknown member, even inserted at its correct canonical (sorted) position, is rejected by the closed payload schema.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-boolean-for-string-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: A boolean value where the schema requires a string is legal, canonical-stable JSON, but a decode type mismatch.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-root-string-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: The root of a signed payload must be a JSON object; "payload" is rejected even though it is canonical and validly signed.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-root-true-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: The root of a signed payload must be a JSON object; true is rejected even though it is canonical and validly signed.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-root-null-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: The root of a signed payload must be a JSON object; null is rejected even though it is canonical and validly signed.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-root-empty-array-validly-signed
bundle_cases.reason: The root of a signed payload must be a JSON object; [] is rejected even though it is canonical and validly signed.

bundle_cases.name: reject/signature-s-plus-l-malleated
bundle_cases.reason: Adding the group order L to a genuine signature's scalar S yields a different encoding of the same group element; RFC 8032 requires S < L, so it is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/timestamp-fractional-seconds
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issued_at of "2026-09-13T00:00:00.000Z" is not the exact UTC-seconds timestamp format the protocol requires.

bundle_cases.name: reject/timestamp-numeric-offset
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issued_at of "2026-09-13T00:00:00+00:00" is not the exact UTC-seconds timestamp format the protocol requires.

bundle_cases.name: reject/timestamp-invalid-calendar-date
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issued_at of "2026-02-30T00:00:00Z" is not the exact UTC-seconds timestamp format the protocol requires.

bundle_cases.name: reject/timestamp-lowercase
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issued_at of "2026-09-13t00:00:00z" is not the exact UTC-seconds timestamp format the protocol requires.

bundle_cases.name: reject/timestamp-hour-24
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issued_at of "2026-09-13T24:00:00Z" is not the exact UTC-seconds timestamp format the protocol requires.

bundle_cases.name: reject/timestamp-space-separator
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issued_at of "2026-09-13 00:00:00Z" is not the exact UTC-seconds timestamp format the protocol requires.

bundle_cases.name: reject/timestamp-missing-zone
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issued_at of "2026-09-13T00:00:00" is not the exact UTC-seconds timestamp format the protocol requires.

bundle_cases.name: reject/uuid-uppercase
bundle_cases.reason: An uppercase-hex agent_id is not a canonical lowercase UUID.

bundle_cases.name: reject/uuid-not-v4
bundle_cases.reason: An agent_id whose version nibble is not 4 is not a valid UUID v4.

bundle_cases.name: reject/uuid-bad-variant
bundle_cases.reason: A nonce whose variant nibble is outside 8/9/a/b is not a valid UUID v4.

bundle_cases.name: reject/uuid-no-dashes
bundle_cases.reason: A nonce without dashes is not a canonical UUID even though it is the same hex digits.

bundle_cases.name: reject/size-leading-zero
bundle_cases.reason: An artifact_size of "00" does not match the required 0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18} decimal-string pattern.

bundle_cases.name: reject/size-negative
bundle_cases.reason: An artifact_size of "-1" does not match the required 0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18} decimal-string pattern.

bundle_cases.name: reject/size-empty
bundle_cases.reason: An artifact_size of "" does not match the required 0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18} decimal-string pattern.

bundle_cases.name: reject/size-too-long
bundle_cases.reason: An artifact_size of "11111111111111111111" does not match the required 0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18} decimal-string pattern.

bundle_cases.name: reject/size-plus-sign
bundle_cases.reason: An artifact_size of "+1" does not match the required 0|[1-9][0-9]{0,18} decimal-string pattern.

bundle_cases.name: reject/digest-uppercase
bundle_cases.reason: An uppercase-hex artifact_sha256 is not the required lowercase hex digest format.

bundle_cases.name: reject/digest-short
bundle_cases.reason: A 63-character artifact_sha256 is one short of the required 64 hex characters.

bundle_cases.name: reject/media-type-no-slash
bundle_cases.reason: A media type without a '/' fails the required MIME-shape check.

bundle_cases.name: reject/media-type-newline
bundle_cases.reason: A media type containing a newline is rejected even though it is a well-formed JSON string.

bundle_cases.name: reject/media-type-too-long
bundle_cases.reason: A 129-byte media type exceeds the 128-byte limit by one.

bundle_cases.name: reject/source-issuer-not-signer-key
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issuer identity that names a fabricated key instead of the actual signer's is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/signed-key-id-mismatch
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issuer_key_id that does not match the envelope's real signing key is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-kind-mismatch
bundle_cases.reason: A payload whose signed kind is agent-acceptance, carried inside an origin-statement envelope, is rejected: the envelope's real kind and the signed kind must match.

bundle_cases.name: reject/payload-protocol-mismatch
bundle_cases.reason: A payload with the wrong protocol identifier is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/missing-referenced-delegation
bundle_cases.reason: A statement that claims a delegation digest while the bundle carries no delegation at all is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: accept/media-type-128-bytes
bundle_cases.reason: A 128-byte media type is exactly at the limit and is accepted.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-uppercase-host
bundle_cases.reason: An uppercase host in the certificate issuer URL is rejected: HTTPS hosts must be lowercase.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-default-port
bundle_cases.reason: An explicit default port 443 is rejected: it must be omitted.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-noncanonical-port
bundle_cases.reason: A port written with a leading zero is not the canonical decimal representation.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-empty-port
bundle_cases.reason: A trailing colon with no port number is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-percent-escape
bundle_cases.reason: A percent-escaped path is rejected: issuer identifiers are exact, unescaped bytes.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-backslash
bundle_cases.reason: A backslash in the issuer is rejected as an ambiguous character.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-query-marker
bundle_cases.reason: A trailing '?' is rejected: issuer identifiers may not carry a query.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-fragment-marker
bundle_cases.reason: A trailing '#' is rejected: issuer identifiers may not carry a fragment.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-http-scheme
bundle_cases.reason: A plain http:// issuer is rejected: only https and opaque URNs are allowed.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-issuer-userinfo
bundle_cases.reason: Embedded userinfo in the issuer URL is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-content-truth-established
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate asserting content_truth=established claims more than a 0.1 issuer may.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-signature-check-invalid
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate whose signature_check is not exactly 'valid' is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-organization-binding-verified
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate asserting organization_binding=verified claims more than a 0.1 issuer may.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-agent-binding-unknown-value
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate agent_binding outside {admin_key_delegation, not_provided} is rejected, isolated on a delegation-free certificate so only that check can fire.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-binding-contradiction
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate claiming agent_binding=not_provided while still carrying a nonempty delegation digest is self-contradictory.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-expiry-not-after-issue
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate whose expires_at equals its issued_at does not satisfy expiry strictly after issuance.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-grafted-onto-other-statement
bundle_cases.reason: A statement re-signed over a different artifact hash no longer matches the certificate that was issued for the original statement.

bundle_cases.name: reject/envelope-kind-relabelled
bundle_cases.reason: An envelope whose transport kind no longer says origin-statement is rejected before any signature or payload check.

bundle_cases.name: reject/statement-by-undelegated-key
bundle_cases.reason: A statement signed by a key that was never delegated, yet still claiming the real delegation's digest, is rejected: the delegated agent key does not match the signer.

bundle_cases.name: reject/acceptance-for-other-delegation
bundle_cases.reason: An acceptance that binds a different delegation's digest than the one the bundle actually carries is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/acceptance-by-wrong-key
bundle_cases.reason: An acceptance signed by the administrator key instead of the delegated agent key is rejected: proof of possession must come from the agent.

bundle_cases.name: reject/delegation-audience-mismatch
bundle_cases.reason: A delegation issued for a different service audience than the certificate issuer is rejected during certificate-time delegation validation.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-source-key-mismatch
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate whose source_key_id names the administrator key instead of the actual statement signer is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-delegation-digest-mismatch
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate whose delegation_sha256 references a different delegation than the one the statement actually cites is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/statement-after-certificate
bundle_cases.reason: A statement claiming to be signed more than the allowed 120-second skew after the certificate's own issued_at is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: accept/statement-within-skew-of-certificate
bundle_cases.reason: A statement issued exactly 120 seconds after the certificate's issued_at is at the inclusive edge of the allowed skew and is accepted.

bundle_cases.name: reject/delegation-expired-at-certificate-time
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate issued after its delegation's expires_at is rejected: the delegation was no longer active at certificate-issuance time.

bundle_cases.name: reject/delegation-not-yet-active-at-certificate-time
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate issued before its delegation's not_before is rejected: the delegation was not yet active at certificate-issuance time.

bundle_cases.name: reject/certificate-outlives-delegation
bundle_cases.reason: A certificate whose expires_at reaches past its delegation's expires_at exceeds the delegation's scope.

bundle_cases.name: reject/statement-before-delegation-not-before
bundle_cases.reason: A statement claiming to be signed before its delegation's not_before exceeds what the delegation could have authorized.

bundle_cases.name: reject/acceptance-before-delegation-not-before
bundle_cases.reason: An acceptance claiming to be signed before its delegation's not_before was not possible: the delegation did not exist yet at that time.

bundle_cases.name: reject/delegation-interval-inverted
bundle_cases.reason: A delegation whose expires_at equals its not_before, rather than strictly after, is individually invalid even though it is validly signed.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-empty
bundle_cases.reason: An empty input has no JSON to parse.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-invalid-utf8
bundle_cases.reason: A single invalid UTF-8 byte inside an otherwise well-formed bundle string is rejected before any JSON parsing.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-utf8-bom
bundle_cases.reason: A UTF-8 BOM before the bundle is not insignificant JSON whitespace and is rejected as malformed.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-trailing-data
bundle_cases.reason: A second complete JSON value after the bundle is rejected as trailing data.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-trailing-garbage
bundle_cases.reason: A stray non-JSON byte after the bundle is rejected as trailing data.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-top-level-array
bundle_cases.reason: A bundle wrapped in a top-level array is not the expected object shape.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-root-string
bundle_cases.reason: The root of a bundle must be a JSON object; "bundle" is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-root-true
bundle_cases.reason: The root of a bundle must be a JSON object; true is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-root-null
bundle_cases.reason: The root of a bundle must be a JSON object; null is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-root-empty-array
bundle_cases.reason: The root of a bundle must be a JSON object; [] is rejected.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-depth-26
bundle_cases.reason: 26 levels of array nesting exceeds the protocol's maximum JSON depth of 24.

bundle_cases.name: reject/input-oversize
bundle_cases.reason: An input one byte over the 262144-byte maximum is rejected outright, before any parsing is attempted.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/duplicate-member
strict_json_cases.reason: Two members with the literally identical name are rejected.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/duplicate-member-escaped-equivalent
strict_json_cases.reason: A second member name written as a unicode escape that decodes to the same string as the first is rejected: duplicate detection compares decoded values, not literal escape text.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/number
strict_json_cases.reason: A bare JSON number value is rejected: 0.1 exact quantities are always decimal strings, never JSON numbers.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/number-in-array
strict_json_cases.reason: A JSON number nested inside an array is rejected the same as a number anywhere else.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/negative-zero
strict_json_cases.reason: The bare numeric literal -0 is rejected: numbers are unsupported as any JSON value, not just inside objects.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/lone-high-surrogate
strict_json_cases.reason: An unpaired UTF-16 high surrogate escape is not valid Unicode text and is rejected.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/lone-low-surrogate
strict_json_cases.reason: An unpaired UTF-16 low surrogate escape is not valid Unicode text and is rejected.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-low-then-high
strict_json_cases.reason: A low surrogate followed by a high surrogate is two unpaired surrogates, not a reversed pair.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-low-then-high-in-member-name
strict_json_cases.reason: A low surrogate followed by a high surrogate is two unpaired surrogates, not a reversed pair. Member names follow the same rule as values.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-high-then-high
strict_json_cases.reason: Two high surrogates in a row are both unpaired.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-high-then-high-in-member-name
strict_json_cases.reason: Two high surrogates in a row are both unpaired. Member names follow the same rule as values.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-low-then-low
strict_json_cases.reason: Two low surrogates in a row are both unpaired.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-low-then-low-in-member-name
strict_json_cases.reason: Two low surrogates in a row are both unpaired. Member names follow the same rule as values.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-high-then-bmp-escape
strict_json_cases.reason: A high surrogate followed by the escape of an ordinary character is unpaired.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-high-then-bmp-escape-in-member-name
strict_json_cases.reason: A high surrogate followed by the escape of an ordinary character is unpaired. Member names follow the same rule as values.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-high-then-literal
strict_json_cases.reason: A high surrogate followed by a literal character is unpaired.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-high-then-literal-in-member-name
strict_json_cases.reason: A high surrogate followed by a literal character is unpaired. Member names follow the same rule as values.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-pair-then-lone-high
strict_json_cases.reason: A valid pair does not excuse an unpaired surrogate after it.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-pair-then-lone-high-in-member-name
strict_json_cases.reason: A valid pair does not excuse an unpaired surrogate after it. Member names follow the same rule as values.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-lone-high-uppercase-hex
strict_json_cases.reason: Hex digits of an escape are case-insensitive; an uppercase unpaired surrogate is still unpaired.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-lone-high-uppercase-hex-in-member-name
strict_json_cases.reason: Hex digits of an escape are case-insensitive; an uppercase unpaired surrogate is still unpaired. Member names follow the same rule as values.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-escaped-backslash-then-lone-high
strict_json_cases.reason: An escaped backslash followed by a real surrogate escape: three backslashes, so the escape is live and unpaired.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/surrogate-escaped-backslash-then-lone-high-in-member-name
strict_json_cases.reason: An escaped backslash followed by a real surrogate escape: three backslashes, so the escape is live and unpaired. Member names follow the same rule as values.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/trailing-comma
strict_json_cases.reason: A trailing comma before the closing bracket is not valid JSON array syntax.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/two-values
strict_json_cases.reason: Two complete top-level JSON values with no separator are rejected as trailing data.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/value-then-object
strict_json_cases.reason: A top-level value followed by whitespace and a second value is rejected as trailing data.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/depth-25
strict_json_cases.reason: 25 levels of array nesting is one past the protocol's maximum JSON depth of 24.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/depth-26
strict_json_cases.reason: 26 levels of array nesting exceeds the protocol's maximum JSON depth of 24.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/oversize
strict_json_cases.reason: An input one byte over the 262144-byte maximum is rejected outright, before any parsing is attempted.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/invalid-utf8
strict_json_cases.reason: A raw invalid UTF-8 byte inside a string value is rejected before any JSON parsing.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/utf8-bom
strict_json_cases.reason: A UTF-8 BOM before the value is not insignificant JSON whitespace and is rejected as malformed.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/empty-input
strict_json_cases.reason: An empty input has no JSON to parse.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/single-quote-string
strict_json_cases.reason: Single-quoted strings are not valid JSON; only double quotes delimit strings.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/unescaped-control-char
strict_json_cases.reason: A raw, unescaped control byte inside a string is not valid JSON: control characters below U+0020 must be escaped.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/leading-zero-number
strict_json_cases.reason: A number with a leading zero followed by more digits is not valid JSON number syntax.

strict_json_cases.name: reject/bare-word
strict_json_cases.reason: An incomplete literal ('nul' rather than 'null') is not a recognized JSON token.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/surrogate-pair-escape
strict_json_cases.reason: A UTF-16 surrogate pair escape decodes to one astral character; canonical form uses the raw 4-byte UTF-8 encoding, not the escape.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/surrogate-pair-uppercase-hex
strict_json_cases.reason: Hex digits of an escape are case-insensitive; an uppercase pair is a valid pair.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/surrogate-pair-in-member-name
strict_json_cases.reason: A valid pair in a member name decodes to one astral character.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/two-surrogate-pairs
strict_json_cases.reason: Consecutive escapes are fine when they form complete pairs.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/replacement-character-literal
strict_json_cases.reason: A literal U+FFFD is an ordinary character, not evidence of a decoding error.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/replacement-character-escape
strict_json_cases.reason: The escape of U+FFFD is not a surrogate; it canonicalizes to the literal character.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/escaped-backslash-then-surrogate-text
strict_json_cases.reason: Two backslashes are one escaped backslash, so the following ud800 is plain text, not an escape.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/two-escaped-backslashes-then-surrogate-text
strict_json_cases.reason: Four backslashes are two escaped backslashes; the following ud800 is still plain text.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/depth-24-boundary
strict_json_cases.reason: 24 levels of array nesting is the largest depth accepted; one more is rejected.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/mixed-scripts-sorting
strict_json_cases.reason: Object members sort by UTF-16 code unit order of the key, not by script, code point or byte order.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/utf16-code-unit-order
strict_json_cases.reason: RFC 8785 section 3.2.3 orders object keys by UTF-16 code unit sequence, not code point or UTF-8 byte order: this is a well-known canonicalization trap. 😀's leading surrogate (U+D83D) sorts before ～'s single code unit (U+FF5E) even though code-point order and UTF-8 byte order both disagree.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/html-chars-unescaped
strict_json_cases.reason: Canonical JSON only escapes what RFC 8785 requires; '<', '>' and '&' are ordinary printable ASCII and are left unescaped.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/control-escapes
strict_json_cases.reason: Canonical JSON uses the named two-character escapes for backspace/form-feed/newline/CR/tab, lowercase-hex \u001f for the unit separator (no named escape exists), and leaves DEL (0x7F) as a raw unescaped byte: only U+0000-U+001F must be escaped.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/escaped-solidus-normalised
strict_json_cases.reason: An escaped solidus is legal JSON but canonicalizes to the literal, unescaped '/'.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/outer-whitespace
strict_json_cases.reason: Insignificant whitespace around tokens is legal JSON and does not affect the canonical result.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/literals
strict_json_cases.reason: The bare literal array [true,false,null] is already canonical.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/empty-object
strict_json_cases.reason: The empty object {} is already canonical.

strict_json_cases.name: accept/empty-string-key
strict_json_cases.reason: An empty string key is legal JSON and round-trips through canonicalization unchanged.
